page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre; page number at top left. Catchword "cap." at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.l: Recens enim est à quodam Leone
Judæo, ante trecentos paulo minus annos con-
fictus & evulgatus. Hujus libri ante hoc
que ego in eum inquirens, plurima no-
quæ jam allata sunt ibi, proponam, quo-
tendentium pars rimam potius, quam e-
ex variis Talmudis & Midraschim locis, in
quibus quæstio est de varia lectione iis-
sa Beth Israël f. 158. cap. 3. ex Tract. [illegible, ~2 letters] עבוד[?] vide misna & Ghemar. f. 29. p. 2. cap.

page.notes: Page number 532 read from the top left; running head "JOH. MORINUS". The first line "rethæ 1527." is read as 1527 but is uncertain. The Hebrew word after "Tract." is illegible; the Hebrew word before "vide" is doubtful. "cap." at the lower right is treated as the catchword. No marginal notes are printed.
